purpose: Test whether the MECH1-dominant LARE gradient-reconstruction error follows the Taylor truncation structure implied by unequal adjacent layer lengths and local capillary-potential curvature.

discovery_status.warning: No blind transfer claim is allowed in MECH4A. Remaining Carsel-Parrish textures are not exposed here and remain available for a later MECH4B falsification.

analytic_derivation.coordinate: x=0 at the tested interface, upper layer x in [-L,0], lower layer x in [0,d], positive downward
exact_mean_expansions: psi_bar_upper = psi0 - L/2 psi' + L^2/6 psi'' - L^3/24 psi''' + O(L^4)
psi_bar_lower = psi0 + d/2 psi' + d^2/6 psi'' + d^3/24 psi''' + O(d^4)
analytic_derivation.key_implication: For equal adjacent lengths L=d the leading psi'' term cancels. Strong layer-length asymmetry makes local curvature a first-order gradient-reconstruction risk.

derivative_estimator.source: fine 10-cm Reference capillary potentials psi=-h at four cell centers x=-15,-5,+5,+15 cm around each tested interface
derivative_estimator.excluded_interfaces: 10 cm and 150 cm lack the symmetric four-center stencil inside the 0-160 cm profile.

actual_error_definition.alignment: Identical to the normalized MECH1 gradient-reconstruction component before multiplication by local K_face.
actual_error_definition.exact_upper_mean: arithmetic depth-average of fine Reference psi over 0-L
actual_error_definition.exact_lower_mean: arithmetic depth-average of fine Reference psi over L-(L+10)
actual_error_definition.reason: Using exact layer-mean psi removes the separately diagnosed constitutive-averaging term and isolates gradient reconstruction.

indicators.role: geometry-only baseline with no hydraulic-state information

indicators.value: RMS over pulse steps of E2
RMS over pulse steps of E3
indicators.role: second plus third derivative Taylor structure corrected to the 10-cm central Reference gradient

per_case: pulse RMS actual normalized gradient error versus L
pulse RMS LENGTH_ONLY, TAYLOR2 and TAYLOR3 indicator versus L
Spearman rank correlation across L between each indicator and actual RMS error
actual peak L and indicator peak L
signed_prediction: sign agreement fraction for E2 and E3 where |E_actual| exceeds 1e-12
aggregation: median absolute peak-location error across cases

adjudication.curvature_indicator_selection: Choose between TAYLOR2_RMS and TAYLOR3_RMS lexicographically by higher median Spearman correlation, then lower median peak-location error, then more exact peak hits.
adjudication.CURVATURE_RANKING_SUPPORTED_AND_TAYLOR3_: Best curvature indicator is strictly better than LENGTH_ONLY on at least one ranking metric and no worse on the others, and pooled RMS(E_actual-E3) < pooled RMS(E_actual-E2) < pooled RMS(E_actual).
adjudication.CURVATURE_RANKING_SUPPORTED_LOCAL_EXPANS: Best curvature indicator dominates LENGTH_ONLY on ranking metrics, but the signed T3 residual chain above does not hold.
adjudication.LOCAL_TAYLOR_STRUCTURE_SUPPORTED_WITHOUT: Signed T3 residual chain holds, but curvature indicators do not dominate LENGTH_ONLY in casewise ranking.
adjudication.TAYLOR_CURVATURE_STRUCTURE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Neither ranking dominance nor the signed T3 residual chain holds.

next_step_firewall.if_supported: A separate MECH4B may freeze a curvature-based grid-risk indicator and test it blindly on previously unused Carsel-Parrish materials such as Sandy Loam, Silt and Clay Loam.
next_step_firewall.if_incomplete: Do not fit coefficients to MECH4A. Consider a nonlocal curvature/integral defect or explicit first-moment state.
next_step_firewall.if_not_supported: Abandon local Taylor curvature as a grid-selection mechanism.
